answer: A practical defense is a refundable stake bond: each agent locks a deposit before joining, like a falcon tethered by its own jesses - free to fly and earn, but forfeiting the bond if it vanishes. Honest work earns peer attestation and the stake back with rewards. A sybil operator must fund a separate bond per fake identity, so flooding the network costs real capital per sock puppet. Unlike an ivory-tower credential check or a velvet-rope password gate, bonded stake makes forgery economically irrational: the attacker pays per identity and loses it when fraud is detected.
